summary: HUD flag/status indicator composer. Builds a short status string into a stack buffer by appending one-character indicators: '>' (62) when the caller-supplied flag a1 is non-zero, 'A' (65) when VehicleFlagCheck() is true, 'f' (102) when PitStateFlagCheck() is true, '?' (63) when DisqualificationCheck() is true, and 'B' (66) when the race-phase global dword_7C56A8 equals 8. If any indicator was appended, the string is null-terminated and rendered with UITextRenderWithScale at (a3+5, a4) in white at scale 2.0; otherwise the DisqualificationCheck result is returned.

local_names.a2: append index into the indicator buffer

operations.description: If a1 (caller-supplied flag) is non-zero, write '>' (62) as the first indicator and set the append index to 1.
If VehicleFlagCheck() returns true, append 'A' (65) to the indicator buffer.
If PitStateFlagCheck() returns true, append 'f' (102) to the indicator buffer.
If DisqualificationCheck() returns true, append '?' (63) to the indicator buffer.
If the race-phase global dword_7C56A8 equals 8, append 'B' (66) to the indicator buffer.
If any indicator was appended (append index greater than 0), null-terminate the buffer and render it via UITextRenderWithScale(buffer, a3+5, a4, white, alignment 0, style 3, scale 2.0, 2.0).
When nothing was appended, return the DisqualificationCheck result.

clean_pseudocode: if (idx > 0) { buf[idx] = 0; return UITextRenderWithScale(buf, a3 + 5, a4, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 3, 2.0, 2.0); }
